objective: Determine whether fixed nesting depth with arbitrarily many names can use a fixed higher unnamed degree and a matched strict-clause source, and whether unrestricted named products implement ordinary extended resolution.
status: Expansion and two-case elimination proved, depth bound conditional: For each fixed nesting depth, any number of names still leaves exponential source-variable proof length on the induced guarded distribution. An arbitrary-depth proof whose declarations all use one original affine factor or its complement has a polynomial two-case elimination in degree two. Fully unrestricted names simulate ordinary extended resolution. (Narrowed 2026-11-16, referee GUARDED-ROUTE-BRANCH-R1: conditional on Pang's unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint, assumption A84.)
title: Many shallow product names and the boundary at extended resolution
